title: Plans and pricing, effective 1 July 2026
text: This price list applies to all new subscriptions and to all renewals from 1 July 2026, and replaces the price list dated 1 April 2025. All prices are in rupees and exclude GST, which is charged at 18 percent on every subscription invoice. Starter costs ₹449 per month and includes 1 user, 1 company and up to 50 sales invoices per month; e-invoicing and e-way bills are not available on Starter. Growth costs ₹1,199 per month and includes 3 users, 2 companies, up to 500 sales invoices per month, 100 e-invoices per month and 100 e-way bills per month. Pro costs ₹2,499 per month and includes 8 users, 5 companies, unlimited sales invoices, 1,000 e-invoices per month, 1,000 e-way bills per month and multi-currency invoicing. Annual billing is charged at the price of 10 months, so a year of Starter costs ₹4,490, a year of Growth costs ₹11,990 and a year of Pro costs ₹24,990, all plus GST. The invoice limit counts sales invoices only; quotations, purchase bills, credit notes and delivery challans do not count. Unused invoices do not carry forward to the next month. When a company reaches its monthly invoice limit, new sales invoices are blocked until the 1st of the next month or until the plan is upgraded, but existing invoices can still be viewed, edited and shared. Customers who were on the April 2025 prices keep them until their first renewal after 30 September 2026.

title: Plans and pricing, effective 1 April 2025 (superseded)
text: Status: superseded on 1 July 2026 by the current price list. This page is kept for reference because some customers are still billed at these prices until their first renewal after 30 September 2026. All prices were in rupees and excluded GST at 18 percent. Starter cost ₹399 per month with 1 user, 1 company and up to 30 sales invoices per month. Growth cost ₹999 per month with 3 users, 2 companies, up to 300 sales invoices per month and 50 e-invoices per month; e-way bills were sold separately at ₹99 for a pack of 50. Pro cost ₹1,999 per month with 10 users, 5 companies, unlimited sales invoices, 500 e-invoices per month and 500 e-way bills per month. Annual billing was offered at the monthly price times 12, less a discount of 15 percent. Under this price list, add-on users cost ₹199 per user per month and were available on Pro only. Multi-currency invoicing was a separate add-on at ₹300 per month on Growth and Pro. Credit notes counted toward the monthly invoice limit under this price list, which was one of the main changes in the July 2026 revision. Customers moving from this price list to the current one at renewal are told by email 30 days in advance.

title: Users, add-on users and accountant access
text: Each plan includes a set number of users, as listed on the current price list. Additional users can be added on Growth and Pro at ₹249 per user per month plus GST; Starter cannot have add-on users and must upgrade. Add-on users are billed for the full calendar month in which they are added, whatever the date, with no proration, and from the next renewal they are billed together with the plan. Removing an add-on user takes effect from the next month, and there is no refund for the current month. Every company on any plan, including Starter, can invite one Accountant login free of charge. The Accountant login does not count toward the user limit. It can view all books, post journal entries, and prepare and file GST returns, but it cannot change billing, delete the company or invite other users. A second accountant from the same firm needs a regular paid user seat. The roles available are Owner, Admin, Staff, Viewer and Accountant. Staff users can create invoices and record payments but cannot see bank balances or payroll. Only the Owner can transfer ownership of an account, which needs an OTP sent to both the old and the new owner's registered mobile numbers. Two-factor login with OTP is mandatory for the Owner and Admin roles and optional for the others.

title: Renewal, auto-debit and subscription invoices
text: Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each monthly or annual term. For customers paying by card or UPI autopay, the renewal payment is attempted 3 days before the renewal date, not on the renewal date itself, so that a failed payment can be fixed before service is affected. If the first attempt fails, it is retried 2 days before and again on the renewal date. Autopay can be set up with a credit card, a debit card or a UPI mandate. Customers paying by net banking or bank transfer get a payment link 7 days before renewal and must pay it manually. Renewal reminders are sent by email and SMS 15 days and 3 days before renewal. Renewals are charged at the price list in force on the renewal date. To get a GST invoice with your GSTIN, so that you can claim input tax credit, add the GSTIN under Settings, Subscription before the payment is made; a subscription invoice cannot be re-issued with a GSTIN after the end of the month in which it was raised. Switching from monthly to annual billing can be done at any time, and the unused days of the current month are adjusted against the annual price. Switching from annual to monthly billing takes effect only at the end of the annual term.

title: Cancellation and refund policy
text: Monthly plans can be cancelled at any time from Settings, Subscription. When a monthly plan is cancelled, the unused whole days of the current month are refunded pro-rata to the original payment method within 7 working days, and the GST on the refunded amount is reversed through a credit note. Annual plans get a full refund only if they are cancelled within 14 days of the first annual payment. After 14 days, annual plans are not refundable, and the plan stays active until the end of the term. The 14-day window applies once per customer and does not apply to renewals. Add-on users, e-invoice top-up packs, payroll add-on charges and assisted migration fees are never refunded, and no refund is given for unused invoice limits. Refunds to UPI and debit cards usually show within 5 working days of being processed; credit card refunds can take up to one billing cycle. Accounts suspended for non-payment, or terminated for misuse of the service, are not eligible for any refund. Refund requests can also be raised with support by quoting the subscription ID, which starts with the letters LW and is printed on every subscription invoice.

title: Non-payment, suspension and data retention, effective 1 January 2026
text: This rule took effect on 1 January 2026 and replaces the earlier rule under which lapsed accounts stayed in read-only mode for 60 days. If a renewal is not paid, the account enters a grace period of 7 days, during which everything works normally and a banner shows the amount due. After the grace period the account is suspended. No user, including the Owner and the Accountant login, can sign in, and data cannot be viewed or exported until the dues are cleared. There is no read-only mode. E-invoices and e-way bills cannot be generated during suspension. Paying the dues in full restores access within 30 minutes, with all data intact. Data of a suspended account is retained for 120 days from the date of suspension, and a final notice is sent by email and SMS on day 90. After 120 days, all companies in the account are permanently deleted, including backups, and cannot be recovered. Customers who plan to stop using the service should export their data before the term ends. Within the 120 days, a customer can ask support for a one-time data export of a suspended account without renewing, on payment of a retrieval fee of ₹999 plus GST; the export is delivered as a Full Export within 3 working days.

title: GST returns, e-invoicing and e-way bills
text: The app prepares GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B from the sales and purchase data in your books. On Growth and Pro, GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B can be filed directly from the app through our GST Suvidha Provider partner, by verifying with an EVC OTP sent to the authorised signatory; filing with a digital signature certificate is supported on Pro only. On Starter, the app prepares the return as a JSON file that you upload on the GST portal yourself. GSTR-9 annual returns and GSTR-4 composition returns cannot be filed from the app; a summary report is provided to help you prepare them. Purchase invoices can be matched with GSTR-2B, which is imported automatically on the 14th of each month on Pro and imported manually on Growth. E-invoices (IRNs) and e-way bills are generated from the invoice screen and count against the monthly quota of your plan: 100 each on Growth and 1,000 each on Pro. Cancelled IRNs still count toward the quota. Top-up packs of 100 e-invoices cost ₹199 plus GST and are valid until the end of the month in which they are bought. GSTIN validation checks the format and the live status of the number; a GSTIN that shows as cancelled or suspended cannot be saved on a customer.

title: Invoice numbering and financial-year closing
text: Each company can have up to 10 invoice series, each with its own prefix, for example by branch or by document type. Invoice numbers are limited to 16 characters including the prefix, and may use letters, digits, hyphen and slash. Numbering does not restart automatically at the start of a financial year: an existing series simply continues on 1 April. To start from 1 for the new year, create a new series for that financial year under Settings, Invoice Series before raising the first invoice of the year. If two invoices end up with the same number, which can happen when a series was edited manually, the second one is flagged and e-invoice generation for it is blocked until it is renumbered. To close a financial year, the Owner or an Admin runs Year-End Closing, which carries forward ledger balances, stock values and outstanding invoices as opening balances. A closed year is locked for editing. Only the Owner can reopen a closed year, and only until 30 November of the following financial year; after that date the year is permanently locked and any corrections must be posted as adjustment entries in the current year. Year-End Closing can be run from 1 April onwards, and you can keep billing in the new year before the old year is closed.

title: Bank feeds: sync and troubleshooting
text: Bank feeds connect a current or savings account so that transactions are pulled in automatically for reconciliation. Bank feeds are available on Growth and Pro only; Starter users can import statements as CSV or XLSX files. On Growth, feeds refresh once a day at about 6 am. On Pro, they refresh every 4 hours and can also be refreshed manually up to 5 times a day. Up to 2 bank accounts can be connected on Growth and up to 10 on Pro. A feed is set up through a consent you give on your bank's own login page, and this consent expires every 180 days. When it expires the feed stops quietly, with only an alert on the dashboard, and the Owner must reconnect it from Banking, Reconnect. This is the most common reason a feed stops working. Other causes are an account that was closed or renamed at the bank, a bank server outage, after which the feed recovers on its own within 48 hours, or a joint account that needs the other holder's approval. Transactions older than 90 days cannot be pulled through a feed and must be imported from a statement. Duplicate transactions after a reconnect can be removed with the Remove duplicates option on the reconciliation screen.

title: Multi-currency invoicing
text: Multi-currency invoicing is available on Pro only. You can raise invoices in 24 foreign currencies, including US dollars, euros, pounds sterling and UAE dirhams. Exchange rates are not fetched automatically: you must enter the exchange rate on each foreign-currency invoice and on each payment received, and the app does not suggest a rate. The base currency of every company is Indian rupees and cannot be changed. When a payment is received at a different rate from the invoice, the difference is posted automatically to the Exchange Gain or Loss ledger. Export invoices can be marked either as supply under LUT without payment of IGST, or as supply with payment of IGST. The LUT reference number and its validity must be entered under Settings, GST before the first export invoice of each financial year, or export invoices under LUT cannot be saved. Foreign-currency invoices show amounts in both the foreign currency and rupees on the PDF. A company that downgrades from Pro to Growth keeps its existing foreign-currency invoices for viewing and reports, but cannot raise new ones or record receipts against them except as a rupee amount.

title: Backups and data export
text: Every company is backed up automatically every night, and nightly backups are kept for 30 days. Customers cannot restore a backup themselves; restore requests go through support, and a restore overwrites all entries made after the backup date. One restore per quarter is free, and further restores cost ₹499 plus GST each. You can export data at any time while the subscription is active. Reports and registers export as XLSX, CSV or PDF. A full company backup downloads as a single encrypted .lwbk file, which can only be opened by importing it into an account on our service; it cannot be read in spreadsheet software. For use outside our service, choose Full Export, which produces a ZIP of CSV files for all masters and transactions plus PDF copies of every invoice. A Full Export of a large company can take up to 6 hours, and a download link valid for 7 days is emailed to the Owner. Attachments such as scanned bills are included in Full Export up to 5 GB per company. All data is stored in data centres in India and is not moved abroad. The mobile app keeps an offline copy of the last 90 days of invoices only; it is not a backup.

title: Support hours and channels
text: Support channels depend on your plan. Starter has email and in-app chat only, from 10 am to 6 pm, Monday to Saturday; there is no phone support on Starter. Growth has email, chat and phone support from 9 am to 7 pm, Monday to Saturday. Pro has priority phone and chat support from 8 am to 10 pm every day, including Sundays, and accounts with 5 companies get a named account manager. On all plans, chat stays open until 11 pm from the 9th to the 11th and from the 18th to the 20th of each month to cover GST filing dates. Support is closed on Republic Day, Independence Day and Diwali. The support phone number is 1800 309 4521. First response targets are 15 minutes on chat and 1 working day on email; Pro email gets a reply within 4 working hours. Callbacks can be booked in the app for a 30-minute slot. Support is available in English, Hindi, Tamil and Marathi. Our staff will never ask for your password or for an OTP, and you never need to share an OTP to get help; report any such request through the in-app chat.

title: Assisted migration for Growth plan customers
text: Customers on Growth can move their books from another accounting software or from spreadsheets either on their own, using the free import templates, or with assisted migration for a one-time fee of ₹2,999 plus GST per company. Assisted migration on Growth covers masters, meaning customers, vendors, items and ledgers, and opening balances as on the cut-over date only. Past transactions are not migrated on Growth. You send us a trial balance, outstanding receivables and payables, and a stock summary as on the cut-over date, in XLSX or CSV format. The migration is completed within 7 working days of receiving complete data, and you get a reconciliation sheet comparing the old and new trial balances. Opening GST input credit is not migrated as a balance and must be entered as a journal by your accountant. The cut-over date must be the first day of a month. The migration fee is not refundable once work has started. If you upgrade from Growth to Pro within 30 days of paying for assisted migration, the fee is credited against your Pro subscription.

title: Assisted migration for Pro plan customers
text: Customers on Pro get assisted migration free of charge for up to 5 companies. Assisted migration on Pro covers masters, meaning customers, vendors, items and ledgers, opening balances as on the cut-over date, and up to 3 years of past transactions, including invoices, bills, receipts and payments, so that prior-year reports can be run inside the app. You send us a trial balance, outstanding receivables and payables, a stock summary and day books for the years to be migrated, in XLSX or CSV format. The migration is completed within 5 working days of receiving complete data. A migration specialist then books a 30-minute verification call to walk through the reconciliation sheet with you or your accountant. Migrations of more than 3 years of history, or of more than 5 companies, are quoted separately at ₹1,500 per extra company and ₹1,000 per extra year. Opening GST input credit is migrated as an opening balance in the electronic credit ledger. The cut-over date can be any date, but the first day of a quarter is recommended.

title: Payroll add-on
text: Payroll is an add-on available on Growth and Pro at ₹40 per employee per month plus GST, with a minimum charge of ₹400 per month; on Pro the first 10 employees are included free. Billing is based on the number of employees for whom a payslip is generated in the month, not the number of employees on record. Payroll calculates salary, PF and ESI contributions, professional tax for 12 states, and TDS on salary under both the old and new tax regimes. It generates the PF return file and the ESI contribution file for upload on the respective portals, but it does not pay the challans for you. Payslips are emailed to employees on the 1st of each month, or on the date you set, and employees can download them through a self-service link. Salaries are not paid out by our service; a bank upload file in a standard CSV format is generated for you to upload in your net banking. Form 16 Part B is generated on Pro only. Payroll cannot be run from the mobile app. The payroll add-on can be switched off at any time and stops billing from the next month.
